evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate WaXup on three benchmarks: hidden-behavior models, a meta-dataset of real-world NLP tasks and AuditBench, a challenging alignment auditing suite of models adversarially trained to conceal their behaviors.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: WaXup improves the accuracy of generated descriptions as well as robustness to various distribution shifts.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
